findings.issue: tests/toolchain/build.test.ts runs the real `npm run build` from REPO_ROOT and asserts on the built index.html (`<title>TLH Trainer</title>`). index.html is not in TOOLING_FILES, so a push that changes only index.html skips Tooling tests. The failure would show up only on the next 06:00 UTC schedule run on main. The checks job's Build step still catches a broken build, so the only uncovered assertion is the title/script check. The spec's A-3 list also leaves it out, so this is a gap in the spec and not a deviation from it.
findings.evidence: tests/toolchain/build.test.ts:15-29 (spawnSync npm run build, cwd REPO_ROOT; readFileSync(join(outDir,'index.html')) expects the title). SPEC-09's literal scan misses it because the read goes through the build output, not a repo literal.
findings.fix: Add 'index.html' to TOOLING_FILES and the README trigger list (spec A-3 amendment), or accept the nightly-only coverage and record that in the story doc.

findings.issue: listFiles keeps only lines matching /^[\w./-]+\.test\.tsx?$/ and drops the rest. The same filter applies to the reference 'all' list, so a test file whose name has another character (space, brackets, '+', '@') would vanish from every list at once. The partition check would then still pass even if no group ran that file. Today all 165 files match (verified: 46 unit + 86 sweeps + 33 tooling = 165, disjoint, equal to the full list).
findings.evidence: tests/toolchain/test-groups.acceptance.test.ts:36-40 filters the output silently; the union is compared with `all`, which went through the same filter.
findings.fix: Keep every non-empty output line after the vitest banner, or assert that the number of filtered lines equals the number of non-empty lines that end in .test.ts(x), so unexpected names fail loudly instead of being dropped.

findings.issue: The CLI adds a `... and N more` line when more than 20 paths match. §5 lists only the reason, up to 20 paths and the final line. This is harmless (the last line is still tooling=<v>) and untested.
findings.fix: Keep it (it helps when reading logs) or drop it to match §5 exactly.

summary: The implementation matches the spec. ci.yml has the six jobs in the spec order with the specified names and steps. Only `tooling` has needs:, and it depends on `changes`. The four non-tooling jobs carry exactly `if: github.event_name != 'schedule'`, and `changes` has no if:, so nothing is skipped on push or pull_request apart from the gated tooling job, which shows as skipped. Every job has timeout-minutes: 30 (ci 6, visual 2, million 1). Every action pin is byte-identical to the base commit. The e2e step bodies are unchanged; the only diff in that job is the removed lint/test steps. Partition verified locally with `npx vitest list --filesOnly` per script: 46 unit + 86 sweeps + 33 tooling = 165, disjoint, union equal to the full list, and all tests/support files land in unit or sweeps. Coverage: --coverage appears only in test:unit, which runs only in the coverage job. The sandbox test proves the 90% headless threshold fails and passes through `npm run test:unit` with the real vite.config.ts. Detector fail-safe paths all return tooling=true with ::warning::: schedule/workflow_dispatch, unknown event, invalid head, zero or empty before with a bad branch or no merge-base, invalid base or base not present (the force-push case), and a git diff failure. A null spawn status maps to -1, which also fails safe. Pull requests use base...head. Usage errors exit 2. Any other exception exits non-zero, which turns the changes job red, so it is never silent. The trigger list covers every literal the tooling tests read, plus CONFIG_FILES and PERF_FILES. The one gap is index.html, which build.test reads through `vite build` (MINOR). The Q-6 locked-test edits keep or tighten intent: per-job exact command lists, exact if: list, six job ids with derived contexts, million pins all equal. The only loosening is the timeout going from 20 to 30. The ANSI fix in test-groups is correct, and the file still matches its locked SHA. The 10 relevant test files pass locally (33 passed, 1 skipped). No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
